edit.statement: 'Is a symptom of' is reflexive: every medical condition is a symptom of itself.
edit.subject: symptom_of
edit.original: 'Is a symptom of' is irreflexive: a symptom is a sign of some other condition, so no condition is a symptom of itself.
edit.scope: Symptom-condition links in medicine; only self-links change.
